about: Derived numbers only (no video, no masks): per-lag whole-silhouette scores (cycle.lag_score, the median aligned 1 - IoU of frame pairs a lag apart) over mask_period's lag range at 24 fps, and the vole's fitted paw tracks. Built 2026-10-16 from chase3d asset-work work folders with vid2godot 15e0ec72 (anim-pipeline-2026-10-16.4). Round 4 (2026-10-17): the round-3 marked fit's paw tracks (voleR3Paws) and facts' averaged cycle of it with the rig's rest bones (voleR3Cycle), from the same work folder at chase3d 9ee3c41e; and the wolf lope's averaged cycle with its e123b61b contact reading (wolfLopeCycle).

voleR3Cycle.builtWith: vid2godot e123b61b (anim-pipeline-2026-10-16.5) facts.loop_rest, the forced leg-identity pass

voleR2Paws.units: metres, in place (the fit's root frame), x forward and z up, raw tail positions

voleR3Paws.units: metres, in place (the fit's root frame), x forward and z up, raw tail positions
voleR3Paws.marks: fit/marks-r3.json: both front toe tips every 4 frames, 0-120; fit --marks --span 0:121

voleR3Cycle.about: facts' averaged cycle of the round-3 fit (the phase-aligned average of its steady cycles, leg identity resolved, before the smooth fit) and what rig_contacts needs to read its contacts: the stride, the rig's rest bones (contract rig.json), the project contract's chains and the paws' rest tail heights

wolfLopeCycle.about: facts' averaged cycle of the chase3d wolf lope fit (the reference body) and rig_contacts' reading of it at vid2godot e123b61b (anim-pipeline-2026-10-16.5): the round-4 body scaling must leave it unchanged
